### How I think & work

<picture><source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="assets/method-dark.svg"><source media="(prefers-color-scheme: light)" srcset="assets/method-light.svg"><img src="assets/method-light.svg" width="860" alt="How I work: 01 Systems thinking, map the full workflow. 02 Customer-first, users shape the draft. 03 Ship and iterate, build, test, improve, looping back to users, or stop and write down why. 04 Ownership, stay until it is adopted."></picture>

<samp>01</samp>&ensp;**Systems thinking.** I map your whole workflow before I automate any piece of it.<br>
<samp>02</samp>&ensp;**Customer-first.** The people who run the work shape the solution from day&nbsp;one.<br>
<samp>03</samp>&ensp;**Ship & iterate.** Prototype fast, test it on your real cases, improve. Or stop, and write down&nbsp;why.<br>
<samp>04</samp>&ensp;**Ownership.** I stay after launch: docs, fixes, onboarding, until your team runs it without&nbsp;me.
